Use case: illustration-story. Create an original informative editorial illustration for ATHENA, an adult German sports-science learning studio. Landscape 1536x1024. A clear TWO-PANEL DIPTYCH, equal left and right halves separated by a narrow ivory gutter. Hand-painted gouache with crisp fine ink, expressive human faces, restrained Pompeian red, warm ivory and muted bronze, generous clean silhouettes, readable at 390px. Modern equipment within a subtly Roman-inspired learning environment; setting supports the subject, never dominates it.
The two panels show DIFFERENT OBSERVATIONS of the SAME adult man wearing the SAME muted red sleeveless sports shirt and charcoal shorts, identical ordinary build, NOT a before/after.
LEFT: side three-quarter view of a seated controlled knee-extension strength test. Man sits upright on a simple modern leg-extension testing chair, thighs supported, knees naturally bent, lower shins against the padded resistance lever, hands resting on side handles. An adult female assessor with a clipboard attentively observes the test. Show mechanically coherent chair and restrained effort, complete visible feet, normal human proportions. Background only a partial ivory column and plain red wall.
RIGHT: the same man lies comfortably supine on the patient table of a clearly recognizable modern MRI scanner, legs toward the short circular bore, head and shoulders outside, no metal weights or jewelry anywhere in this panel. A simple calm ivory imaging room with a muted red architectural accent. No exposed internal anatomy, no scan image, no readable monitor, no tape measure. The scanner represents observing muscle size by a different method, not diagnosis or treatment.
Both panels visually equal, no arrows between them, no chronology, no body transformation, no size change, no dramatic muscle definition. Composition is an illustrative conceptual comparison, NOT a scientific apparatus blueprint or reconstruction of any study. No owl, amphora, still-life counter, trophies, laurel, text, numbers, charts, watermarks or logos. All important subjects comfortably within frame; no text baked in, accessible German labels will be provided separately by the app.

Use case: illustration-story. Create an original informative editorial illustration for ATHENA, an adult German sports-science learning studio. Landscape 1536x1024. Distinctive CLOSE OVERHEAD editorial illustration of active planning and comparing records, not a room vista or static decorative still life. Hand-painted gouache, crisp fine ink, expressive gestural hands, warm ivory paper, Pompeian red portfolio, muted bronze clips, a small edge of Roman mosaic. Clear large shapes and only a few objects, readable at 390px.
An open THREE-SECTION work portfolio fills almost the whole frame. Three clear equally sized vertical areas, left, middle, right, separated by generous blank paper gutters.
LEFT: a cropped adult hand entering from the lower left is visibly moving one large paper card between two marked slots in a planning sheet. The card contains only one bold simple dumbbell pictogram to stand for a training requirement. An unused pencil lies nearby. This is a decision to change a planned task.
MIDDLE: exactly ONE observation sheet held in a simple bronze paper clip, with a tiny neutral monochrome clipboard pictogram and a few broad abstract horizontal writing strokes. One individual record, no score, no star, no highlight as winner.
RIGHT: exactly THREE matching observation sheets of the same design as the middle one, slightly staggered sideways so each is clearly visible. A second adult hand entering from lower right points across the three sheets to compare them. Same-size sheets and same-height abstract writing strokes, NO rising values or implied monotonic improvement.
The visual contrast must be immediately clear: actively modifying a plan / one record / comparing several records. Hands anatomically plausible, five fingers each, naturally grasping or pointing, no extra hands. No legible writing, numbers, dates, graphs, scales, arrows, checkmarks, grades, growth curves or ranking. No guarantee of success, no personal exercise prescription. No owl, bell, laurel, amphora, marble counter or background room. This is a fictional conceptual teaching scene, not data. Atmospheric Roman colors and paper textures are supporting elements. German titles and precise explanation are supplied as accessible HTML outside the image.
